name: polar_bands
rule: STRIDED, DISJOINT, FROZEN AT BIRTH. wheel w owns the planes p == offset_w (mod stride_w); strides are powers of two with distinct residues, so the three bands cannot collide (asserted by the head's reader). Strided rather than contiguous: nothing recommends a contiguous corner of the 512-d waist (the legacy BREATH_BAND_PAIRS 24..31 was a v0 reservation that never governed a trained head, and ROT_BANDS was drafted per 64-d attention head, not for the state), while a uniform stride guarantees the clock samples the whole plane-index range and, reshaped (MX_HEADS, planes/head), lands the same allocation in every mixer head. Sizes 32/16/16 = 64 of 256 planes (25.0%, a power of two — the word 2026-09-08) clocked, 192 content: enough common-mode energy for the breath probe to read the phase, little enough that 75% of the direction passes through bit-identically (cos=1, sin=0).

wheels.name: breath_hand
wheels.job: the address: (k-1)*60 deg, unique across the six loop breaths

wheels.name: pass_wheel
wheels.job: 60 deg per FULL PASS; static this era (single-pass) — reserved spectrum

content_planes_note: every plane not listed in a wheel is CONTENT: cos=1, sin=0, bit-identical passthrough
dim_map: plane p occupies waist dims (2p, 2p+1) — the interleaved-real convention of _rot2 / rotor_clock.cycle_cos_sin
qside_note: the SAME plane indices drive the Q-side mixer rotation (reshaped to (MX_HEADS, n_planes/MX_HEADS)) so state and attention share ONE clock
